title: Add request‑body validation middleware
description: Introduces a lightweight, zero‑dependency validation middleware that checks incoming JSON bodies against a developer‑provided schema and returns a 400 error on mismatch. This reduces boiler‑plate validation code and prevents malformed data from reaching route handlers, improving security and reliability.
testCases: Valid payload matching schema passes through to the handler
Invalid payload returns 400 with descriptive error message
acceptance: When a route registers the validation middleware with a schema, any request whose JSON body conforms to the schema proceeds to the next handler; otherwise the response status is 400 and the body contains an error detailing the first failing rule. Middleware must not interfere with other middlewares, works with async handlers, and logs validation errors at debug level.
reason: Ensures data integrity across the framework without adding external dependencies, addressing a common pain point for developers and reducing runtime errors in production.
